newsitem.title: USA: Boston Communications gets AT&T Wireless.
newsitem.headline: Boston Communications gets AT&T Wireless.

text.p: Boston Communications Group Inc said Thursday it has been selected by AT&T Corp's AT&T Wireless Services as its prepaid vendor.
Boston Communications Group will provide prepaid services for a number of AT&T Wireless Services' cellular and personal communications services markets, it said.

"With the selection, Boston Communications Group's wireless prepaid service will be available to over 80 percent of the United States population," company chairman, president and chief executive officer Paul Tobin said in a press release.
Boston Communications stock was up 2-5/16 to 12-1/16 in midafternoon trading on the Nasdaq exchange.
